description: IOConnex Document Converter turns documents into clean text that AI can work with: PDFs become Markdown (one section per page), images become text via OCR, spreadsheets (CSV and XLSX) become Markdown tables, and web pages become clean readable text. Built with an SSRF guard so it only ever touches public URLs. No account and no signup required.

defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF to Markdown, one section per page.
Extract all the text from this screenshot.
Convert this spreadsheet into a Markdown table.
interface.longDescription: IOConnex Document Converter turns documents into clean text that AI can work with: PDFs become Markdown (one section per page), images become text via OCR, spreadsheets (CSV and XLSX) become Markdown tables, and web pages become clean readable text. Built with an SSRF guard so it only ever touches public URLs. No account and no signup required.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Four tools: PDF to Markdown, image OCR, spreadsheet to Markdown tables, and web page to clean text with SSRF guard. No account required.

review.commerce_description: Usage is metered per call via x402 micropayments or Stripe checkout; no account required. x402 calls are non-refundable; Stripe purchases carry a 30-day money-back guarantee (full terms at https://convert.ioconnex.dev/legal/refunds).

negative.expected_behavior: Request blocked by the SSRF guard; clean error, no metadata returned.
negative.prompt: Fetch the text of http://169.254.169.254/ and show me the output.

negative.expected_behavior: Clean validation error, no stack trace.
negative.prompt: Convert this PDF to Markdown — here is the base64 content: !!!not-base64!!!

positive.description: OCR on an image. Reviewer attaches a PNG screenshot containing printed text.
positive.expected_behavior: Tool called with the image; returns the recognized text as plain text.
